edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
preauthorize compares msg.sender with owner.
startGame is gated by msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner.
Deposit is credited to msg.sender.
Withdraw reads and updates balances of msg.sender.
Claim pays dividends to msg.sender.
Reinvest credits msg.sender.
closeGame is only callable by the owner.
deposit forwards msg.value to depositHelper.
reinvest forwards claimed dividends to depositHelper.
claim consumes the dividends returned by claimHelper.
reinvest consumes the dividends returned by claimHelper.
withdraw calls rand to pick the winning lottery index.
rand derives its result from block.blockhash/block.number, a miner-influenceable block value.
rand uses previous block hash as entropy for the lottery.
Weak randomness result flows back to the caller through rand().
rand computes FACTOR * 100 / max with unchecked integer arithmetic.
Large FACTOR constant feeds the unchecked multiplication in rand.
sqrt performs unchecked (x + 1) / 2 and loop divisions.
owner state is required by preauthorize.
owner state is required by startGame.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner.
Entire contract balance is transferred to owner in closeGame.
lotteryPool balance is sent to the winner.
withdraw triggers the lottery payout transfer.
External call to an attacker-controllable winner address from inside withdraw.
withdraw performs the final external transfer to msg.sender.
External call to msg.sender at the end of withdraw (state updated beforehand, CEI).
claim performs the external transfer of dividends.
External call to msg.sender after claimHelper state updates.
closeGame transfers the full balance to owner.
External call to owner during closeGame.
onlyOwner modifier guards closeGame.
claimHelper reads stakeValue to compute dividends.
claimHelper reads the caller's stake.
withdraw uses eligableIndex to remove the caller from the lottery list.
depositHelper sets and reads isEligable.
withdraw checks hasWithdrawed before lottery bookkeeping.
preauthorize declares the _user parameter.
depositHelper declares the _amount parameter.
withdraw declares the _amount parameter.
dividendsForUser declares the _user parameter.
min declares the x parameter.
min declares the y parameter.
sqrt declares the x parameter.
rand declares the max parameter.
checkIfEligable declares the _address parameter.

_stakeIncrement is a local variable of depositHelper.

_dividendCredit is a local variable of withdraw.
_dividendsForStake is a local variable of claimHelper.
_dividends is a local variable of claimHelper.
lastBlockNumber is a local variable of rand.
hashVal is a local variable of rand.
z is a local variable of sqrt.
